title: macOS platform observation boundary
description: Objective: land the production macOS/darwin platform observation and classification surface that cross-host conformance and the portability shadow gate can evaluate without inheriting Linux facts. Deliverable: focused runner macOS modules, public root seam, and hostile-shape tests. NOT in scope: claiming live macOS execution on this Windows host, packaging certification, spawning processes, or weakening Windows/Linux. Measured at HEAD 30458af: the OS-neutral platform contract and Linux classifier are public from task-f01ef545b1554a2cb5df340ce78f6a5c, but packages/runner/src/platform/macos/** is absent; observeLinuxPlatform deliberately returns PLATFORM_HOST_MISMATCH/PLATFORM_LINUX for darwin. Consumers: archived macOS conformance task-e94b2055e281489ea9e97820919f6856 and task-22cfca91c5134b24aaf3e5734444fb93. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/platform/macos/** plus minimal runner root/surface tests.
definitionOfDone: A macOS classifier covers every frozen PLATFORM_BOUNDARIES member and maps caller-supplied darwin facts to PROVEN or UNKNOWN with stable macOS-specific layer/codes; the exact non-empty boundary set is hand-pinned.

Missing, stale, hostile, off-host, unsupported-architecture, unpinned-runtime, path/symlink, lock, signal, and recovery facts never become PROVEN and assert exact reason code/layer with zero accessor reads.
The adapter composes existing provider/workspace/scope/cancellation/recovery shapes and contains no child_process/spawn/kill/clock/random probing or copied lifecycle/authority logic.

The curated @moe/runner root exposes the macOS surface with exact LF bridges, bare-specifier typecheck, and plain-Node loadability; task-e94b2055e281489ea9e97820919f6856 and task-22cfca91c5134b24aaf3e5734444fb93 are recorded consumers.
taskRails: This task ships a boundary, not conformance evidence; do not claim a macOS PASS without a macOS host.
Do not reuse PLATFORM_LINUX layer or Linux verdicts for darwin.
Target <=250 lines per production file and split before 400.

implementationPlan.description: Make the neutral contract admit, but not implement, macOS. In platform-contract.ts add PLATFORM_MACOS as the exact third PlatformLayer without changing PLATFORM_BOUNDARIES, PLATFORM_ERROR_CODES, truth classes or observation version. Replace the Object.keys exactness check in snapshotExactRecord with Reflect.ownKeys and require every expected field to be an enumerable own data descriptor; catch reflective proxy/descriptor failures and return null rather than throw so hostile input remains UNKNOWN with PLATFORM_FACT_MALFORMED. Keep the file at the <=250-line target with line-neutral refactoring and preserve all Linux-visible behavior.
implementationPlan.note:
Neutral contract now ADMITS macOS without implementing it. platform-contract.ts is exactly 250 lines (`grep -c ''` = 250, unchanged from before this step — every added line was paid for by compressing existing prose, not by growing the file). No line exceeds 110 chars (`awk 'length > 110'` printed nothing).

1. PLATFORM_LAYERS is now the exact three-member frozen tuple ["PLATFORM_CONTRACT","PLATFORM_LINUX","PLATFORM_MACOS"]. PLATFORM_BOUNDARIES (7), PLATFORM_ERROR_CODES (9), PLATFORM_TRUTH_CLASSES (2) and PLATFORM_OBSERVATION_VERSION are byte-identical — no new macOS-specific reason code was invented, which is the decision recorded in the `decision-macos-platform-boundary-surface` memory.

2. snapshotExactRecord hardened, three changes:
   - exactness counted over `Reflect.ownKeys(value).length` instead of `Object.keys(value).length`. Object.keys reports neither symbol-keyed nor non-enumerable own properties, so both were places to hide a field from a count that claims to be exact.
   - each expected key must now additionally satisfy `descriptor.enumerable === true` on top of the existing `"value" in descriptor` data-property check. Without this, moving to Reflect.ownKeys would newly ACCEPT a non-enumerable expected field that the old count happened to reject — a net weakening.
   - the whole body is wrapped in try/catch returning null. Every reflective call here is proxy-trappable and can be made to throw; refusing is the fail-closed answer, and propagating would turn hostile input into an exception out of a seam whose callers can only handle a refusal.
   Accessor properties were already rejected with zero reads via the descriptor path; that is preserved, not introduced.

ZERO other test moved: the baseline was 58 files / 1880 tests green, and the 56 files that still collect are all green. implementationPlan.description: Implement macos/macos-boundary.ts and its exact LF bridge. Expose classifyMacosBoundary and re-export the Macos payload/context types and PLATFORM_MACOS_LAYER. For a known boundary, snapshot the caller-supplied context and envelope without invoking accessors, bind the envelope host exactly to the asserted context host, require canonical instants and a safe freshness window, reject future/stale or caller-UNKNOWN evidence, then invoke the macOS payload validator. Preserve the landed gate order and PlatformBoundaryVerdict/PlatformFailure union: an unknown boundary or malformed context refuses at PLATFORM_CONTRACT; every host/freshness/payload refusal for a valid boundary is UNKNOWN at PLATFORM_MACOS with its exact boundary.
implementationPlan.note:
Single-boundary darwin classifier landed. macos-boundary.ts is 184 physical lines, LF only (`grep -c $'\r'` = 0), no line over 100 chars. Bridge macos-boundary.js verified with `cat -A` as the exact one line `export * from "./macos-boundary.ts";$`.

Exposes classifyMacosBoundary and readMacosClassificationContext; re-exports PLATFORM_MACOS_LAYER and the type closure MacosBoundaryPayloads / MacosClassificationContext / MacosPathFact / MacosWorkspaceFact from macos-facts.js.

Return type is the landed union PlatformBoundaryVerdict | PlatformFailure, and the two-layer split is preserved exactly:
- an unusable boundary NAME refuses at PLATFORM_CONTRACT with PLATFORM_BOUNDARY_UNKNOWN and boundary null — a fact about the call, not about a host, so there is no verdict to attach;
- a malformed classification context refuses at PLATFORM_CONTRACT with PLATFORM_FACT_MALFORMED but DOES name the boundary, since the boundary itself was usable;
- every host / freshness / payload refusal for a valid boundary is a frozen verdict with truthClass UNKNOWN whose failure carries PLATFORM_MACOS and that exact boundary.

Gate order preserved from the landed Linux classifier, and it is load-bearing: absent -> exact-envelope shape -> readable host -> host binding -> canonical instant + truthClass vocabulary -> freshness -> caller's own truth claim -> payload. Nothing later can raise an earlier UNKNOWN back to PROVEN, and an input cannot score better by omitting a field than by supplying a bad one.

Host binding is to the host the CONTEXT asserts (hostIdentityMatches over all three fields), not to "something darwin-ish" — a fact observed on a different mac is still a fact about a different mac. Freshness compares two caller-supplied instants through canonicalEpochMillis; a post-dated fact (ageMs < 0) is refused PLATFORM_FACT_STALE rather than credited, which is the cheapest way to defeat a window implemented as a subtraction.

No accessor is ever invoked: the envelope and the context are both lifted through the hardened snapshotExactRecord, and the payload validator reads only own data descriptors. No clock, environment or process read anywhere — canonicalEpochMillis is the pure instant helper, not Date. No linux-* import.

Linux", "refuses a fully coherent linux observation, so darwin inherits no Linux verdict", "attributes every darwin refusal to PLATFORM_MACOS or PLATFORM_CONTRACT, never PLATFORM_LINUX", and the root drive test. Worth recording WHY only 4: every `expect(failure.layer).toBe(PLATFORM_MACOS_LAYER)` compares against the same constant and therefore survives this mutation. 2a. Reflect.ownKeys -> Object.keys -> 2 red (symbol-keyed extra, non-enumerable extra), both with "LOCK was not refused" — i.e. the smuggled record was CREDITED, an outcome assertion not a message assertion.
2b. drop `descriptor.enumerable !== true` -> 1 red, "refuses an expected field that is present but not enumerable", again "LOCK was not refused". Confirms 2a and 2b guard different cases and neither is redundant.
2c. replace the fail-closed `catch { return null }` with a throw -> 1 red, "refuses a proxy whose reflection traps throw", failing with the injected message raised out of snapshotExactRecord through macos-boundary.ts:90 — proving the seam would otherwise propagate.
3a. bypass envelope host binding -> 1 red, exactly "refuses a darwin fact whose envelope host disagrees with the declared host".
3b. invert the closure pin guard to `!isClosure` -> 2 red: "refuses an unpinnable runtime closure on RUNTIME_CLOSURE only" ("RUNTIME_CLOSURE was not refused") and the reason-code closure sweep.
4. bypass the darwin OS short-circuit -> 3 red: coherent-linux, coherent-win32 and the code sweep.
